name: linkedin-decision-maker-outreach
description: Research, draft, approve, and safely dispatch small batches of LinkedIn messages to relevant first-degree connections.

interface.shortDescription: Create and dispatch reviewed LinkedIn outreach.
interface.longDescription: Turn a LinkedIn connections export, an offer, and target roles into researched drafts in an approval CSV, then dispatch exact approved messages through an authorized connector or manual handoff.
defaultPrompt: Create an outreach tracker from my offer and LinkedIn connections export.
Research the approved target companies and draft concise LinkedIn messages.
Prepare up to five sealed messages for confirmed dispatch from my tracker.
